notes.title: The Lawyer (DEVLOG #2)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello again![/h1]

Sorry for the long silence, but we've got a handful of work with this one :D We're getting closer and closer to something playable. Most of gameplay's mechanics are alive and kicking. Now we are doing some refactors, lots of scripting, and even more putting stuff together, to make the best game possible.

[h1]What's new[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41700917/104e9eae8aa68a00f271e5db80c327b1e99989c3.png[/img]

[b]New level: Detention Center[/b]
This is most likely where you'll meet your clients and have a little chat with them.

[b]New level: DA's office (WIP)[/b]

[b]Inventory[/b]
A simple inventory system for each playable character, to store some gameplay related items, like pass cards, or keys. + Integration with dialogue system

[b]Optimization[/b]
We managed to get rid of some bottlenecks in game's performance, and speed loading times up a little.

[b]Game progression system finished[/b]
System that keeps track of player's doings, and what should happen next. Looks pretty decent.

[b]Motion capture testing[/b]
First tests of the mocap system look good so far. We have to introduce retargeting into our pipeline, but it also shows promising results in the current state. 

[b]Dialogue and gameplay scripting[/b]
We are also scripting dialogues, sequences, and game progression at this stage.

[b]Assets[/b]
Our design team is polishing the levels, and in the same time working on [b]characters[/b], and [b]props[/b].

[h3]Mechanics[/h3]
We're constantly adding new mechanics to the game, and trying to put together the best possible mix. In this stage also some balancing takes place, as we're trying to figure out which elements should be emphasized to give players the most "lawyer" feel.

Generally speaking, there's a lot of putting stuff together and checking if it fits and feels properly :D

[h3]Stay tuned[/h3]
Stay tuned folks. We should have some sneak peaks of the gameplay in the nearby future :)
Cheers

notes.title: The Lawyer (DEVLOG #1)
notes.content:
[h1]Devlog #1[/h1]

[h2]Hello folks![/h2]

[i]First we want to thank you for your feedback on this project. :D
We've seen some comments regarding poor animation quality. We want you to know, that we heard you and we've made a decision to use a [b]motion capture[/b] system for character animations.[/i]

Now for the devlog

[h2]What's new:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41700917/886d401dcc1168644a12dcc1cd327bd12529b192.png[/img]

[b]New level - "Ferry & Sonnenberg" Office[/b]
Mark's second home. You'll be spending some time here, trying to connect the dots, working on a case. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41700917/48e64eb2c3117b0d6c90274437b68e5898f7b6a3.png[/img]

[b]Settings, and some boring backend stuff. (UI is work in progress)[/b]
This is just something, that you have to get out of your way... And because we have now finished it, we can move to some more interesting things :)

[b]Game progression system (WIP)[/b]
This is a crucial part of the game and also most prone to bugs, because of it's complexity. This system will be responsible for spawning/killing characters and objects, locking/unlocking locations, taking care of dialogue options and many other things.

[h3]What else we've been up to:[/h3]
[list]
[*] General optimization
[*] Level fixes
[*] New assets
[*] Quick travel
[*] Loading screen
[/list]

[h3]That's all folks![/h3]

Thanks for showing interest in The Lawyer :D
We'll try to post devlogs in 2-3 week intervals, to keep you up to speed with the project.
Stay tuned!
